meta.subtitle: Renders JSON or Markdown pages in the browser. Single-source content, no build step for authoring, multi-page site with full-text search when you want one.
meta.summary: What the kit is, how it's organised, where the documentation lives.

blocks.summary: Pages are JSON or Markdown. The browser renders them via Custom Elements; no build step needed to read. Run oku build to emit a multi-page site (with Pagefind search) or a standalone single file for offline reading.
bullets: Source: <name>.json (kit schema) or <name>.md (existing Markdown drops in unchanged).
Runtime: chrome.js + renderer.js load from a _kit symlink. No copies, no version drift.
Primitives: callout, kpi-grid, table, compare-grid, step-flow, chart, diagram, live-snippet, annotated-code, glossary tooltips, citation cards.
Output: dist/site/ (multi-page + Pagefind) and dist/standalone/ (single file with inline page JSON for email / archive).

blocks.title: Documentation
blocks.lead: Eight pages. Cards link straight to each — Reference covers core primitives; Charts / Tables / Diagrams break out the heavy ones; Glossary / Architecture / CLI go deeper.

steps.title: Reference
steps.content: Project setup, page anatomy, Markdown sources, the prose / emphasis / structured-layout primitives, per-page metadata, build outputs.

steps.title: Charts
steps.content: Every chart variant with a tiny live sample, grouped by intent (categorical / distribution / time series / hierarchy / relationship / multivariate / flow / graph / geographic) plus the rich-hover + click-to-pin + pan/zoom fullscreen behaviour shared across them.

steps.title: Tables
steps.content: table primitive — flat rows, grouped rows, chip filters, board / kanban view, sticky headers, drag-resize columns, word-wrap by default.

steps.title: Diagrams
steps.content: diagram primitive + every Mermaid v10 type the kit forwards (flowchart, sequence, state, ER, class, gantt, pie, journey, mindmap, timeline, sankey-beta, ...). Theme tokens flow through.

steps.title: Glossary & ext-refs
steps.content: File layout, multi-language entries, project overrides, disambiguation syntax, resolution algorithm.

steps.title: Architecture
steps.content: How the kit fits together at runtime — render flow, tooltip controller, kit loader, build pipeline, standalone bundle. Read this when extending or debugging the kit itself.

steps.title: CLI reference
steps.content: Five commands. What each does, what output to expect, the doctree linter's severity table, the optional Pagefind and jsonschema dependencies.

steps.title: Roadmap
steps.content: Ten phases, every tracked item, the principles driving the rewrite, and the open questions still on the table.

blocks.title: What a page looks like
blocks.lead: Two source formats produce the same rendered page. Pick whichever fits the content — JSON for kit-native authoring, Markdown for prose that should drop in unchanged. Code on the left, the actual rendered output on the right.

blocks.content: Hand-authored or AI-emitted. Every block declares its kind explicitly; nothing has to be guessed. Validated against the kit schema before it ships.

output.title: Heads up
output.content: Callouts carry one of seven tones: info, tip, note, neutral, success, caution, danger.

blocks.content: Drop existing .md files into the docs root. ATX headings, code fences (mermaid included), lists, tables, blockquotes, inline formatting all convert. Relative .md links retarget to .html. README / CHANGELOG / CLAUDE.md and friends are surfaced as pages too.

blocks.title: Quickstart
blocks.lead: Three commands. Adopt the kit for an existing docs/ directory without rewriting anything.

blocks.source:
cd path/to/your-project/docs
oku init     # creates _kit symlink + index.html
oku serve    # http://localhost:9876 with live reload
